title: Process Context
description: Schema for Process Context entries in technehub-labs/dea-catalog-processes. CR-BP-02. A Process Context is the bounded enterprise context established by the intersection of an ECF Domain and a Lifecycle Stage, within which Business Process responsibilities are identified, organized, and validated. The Process Context is NOT itself a Business Process; it is a contextual construct that scopes process discovery. Sub-classifications of Business Process (operational / support / management) remain catalog-internal via the catalog's process_intent field; sub-classifications do NOT promote to root-model entities (BP-SPEC-01-007 in CR-BP-SPEC-BP-01).

id.description: Stable identity. Convention: dea:pc-<domain-abbrev>-<stage-abbrev> (e.g. dea:pc-pr-op = PartyAndRelationship x Operate). The id must be stable across renames of name/definition; renames go through the CR-programme.

domain.description: Canonical ECF Domain. Must resolve to one of seven values (GovernanceAndExistence, StrategyAndDirection, AgencyAndOrganization, PartyAndRelationship, ProductAndValue, EnablementAndOperations, FinanceAndAccounting). The authoritative vocabulary lives in dea-metaframework/schemas/ecf-domain.schema.json (CR-ECF-003, CR-ECF-005); the catalog must NOT redefine it. Runtime enforcement: scripts/check_process_context.py (PC-001).

lifecycle_stage.description: Canonical ECF Lifecycle Stage. Must resolve to one of seven values (Conceive, Design, Build, Activate, Operate, Improve, Retire). The authoritative vocabulary lives in dea-metaframework/schemas/ecf-stage.schema.json (CR-ECF-004, CR-ECF-005); the catalog must NOT redefine it. Runtime enforcement: scripts/check_process_context.py (PC-002).

plain_language_name.description: Human-readable, business-familiar name for this entity (CR-BP-230 S2). Must remain semantically equivalent to the canonical `name` - a familiar rendering, not an informal synonym that introduces ambiguity. Naming principles: CR-BP-230 S3. Authored in CR-BP-233..236.

plain_language_description.description: Everyday explanation of what this entity represents and what happens in practical terms (CR-BP-230 S2). Rendered in README Part I (In a nutshell / What this means in everyday work). Must not restate the formal `definition` verbatim (MECE, CR-BP-230 S1); metamodel jargon denied by CR-BP-232 HUM gates.

business_purpose.description: Why this entity exists and the business significance it carries (CR-BP-230 S2). Rendered in README Part I (Why it matters).

practical_context.description: When and where this work is encountered in everyday operations (CR-BP-230 S2). Rendered in README Part I (When you'd encounter it).

agent_type.description: The kind of agent illustrated by the example: human (a person performs it), non-human (automation/system performs it), mixed (human-with-system). At L4, defaults from the record's `responsibility` field; author-refinable (CR-BP-230 S2).

narrative.description: Office-relatable worked example of the entity being carried out by the stated agent type (CR-BP-230 S2). Rendered in README Part I (Worked example).

worked_example.description: Worked example of this entity being performed by an agent of type human or non-human (CR-BP-230 S2, owner directive 2026-11-05).

definition.description: Normative semantic meaning of this Domain x Lifecycle intersection. Not a description; a definition. PC-006 enforces charter completeness.

excludes.description: Explicitly excluded responsibilities (belong in adjacent contexts).

outcomes.description: Intended enterprise outcomes for this context.

adjacent_contexts.description: References to other Process Context ids (dea:pc-...) that have legitimate relationships with this one. Relationships do NOT imply duplicated ownership (CR-BP-02 §11).

processes.description: References to canonical Business Process specialization entries belonging to this context. Must resolve to dea:BusinessProcess specialization ids (PC-008 / BP-SPEC-01-002). CR-BP-02 explicitly does NOT populate this list — process discovery is gated on the context being established first.

combined_semantic_meaning.description: Required semantic confluence of domain + lifecycle. PC-006 enforces.

cell_charter.description: Cell Charter (CR-BP-02 §7): the discovery and validation instrument for this context. PC-006 / AC-04 / AC-05 enforce.

status.description: Process Context lifecycle status (CR-BP-02 §17). Defaults: 'defined' once the cell charter is complete; 'established' once the validation gate has confirmed it.

governance.description: Operational governance block (EXT-24 L0 register): role assignment + provenance.

roles.description: Governance roles assigned to this context (GOV-002 role-based).

provenance.description: Assignment provenance: source CR, assertion date, review_due.

metrics.description: Target metrics register (EXT-24 L0 register; CR-BP-120 metrics shape): KPI/KRI/KCI entries.

metricEntry.description: One metric/indicator entry (name, directional target, measurement frequency).
